metadata.article_title: Right of arrested person to meet an advocate of his choice during interrogation

article.title: Right of arrested person to meet an advocate of his choice during interrogation
article.content: When any person is arrested and interrogated by the police, he shall be entitled to meet an advocate of his choice during interrogation, though not throughout interrogation.
article.html:
38Right of arrested person to meet an advocate of his choice during interrogation

Section 38 · Chapter V

When any person is arrested and interrogated by the police, he shall be entitled to meet an advocate of his choice during interrogation, though not throughout interrogation.
